traduccion: Delante de la estación hay un comedor de precios razonables. Al llegar el mediodía se llena de gente que trabaja por la zona. Un cliente de la mesa de al lado estaba riñendo a gritos a alguien del local. El motivo era sólo que el pedido tardaba. Se le mezclaban palabras vulgares y al oírlo se te hacía cuesta arriba. El encargado pidió perdón varias veces, pero un cliente mayor que estaba al lado dijo en voz baja: «eso no está bien». Con esa sola frase, dicha sin levantar la voz, el ambiente del local volvió a su sitio. Que a uno le moleste esperar quizá sea lo lógico. Aun así, cómo lo dices sí puedes elegirlo.

traduccion_en: In front of the station there's a canteen with reasonable prices. When midday comes it fills up with people who work nearby. A customer at the next table was telling off one of the staff at the top of his voice. The reason was simply that his order was slow. Coarse words were mixed in with it and listening to it became hard going. The manager apologised several times, but an older customer sitting near by said quietly: «that isn't right». With that one sentence, said without raising his voice, the atmosphere in the place came back. That being kept waiting annoys you is perhaps only natural. Even so, how you say it is something you can choose.
